# d)
```{r}
# The log-likelihood gradient function
gradient <- function(beta, x, y){
  beta0 <- beta[1]
  beta1 <- beta[2]
  
  eta <- beta0 + beta1 * x
  pi  <- pnorm(eta)      # normale CDF function
  phi <- dnorm(eta)      # normale density function
  
  grad0 <- sum(phi * (y - pi) / (pi * (1 - pi)))
  grad1 <- sum(x * phi * (y - pi) / (pi * (1 - pi)))
  
  c(grad0, grad1)
}

# The log-likelihood hessian function
hess <- function(beta, x, y){
  eta <- beta[1] + beta[2] * x
  pi  <- pnorm(eta)
  phi <- dnorm(eta)
  
  w <- (phi^2)/(pi*(1-pi)) # + (y-pi)*phi*eta/(pi*(1-pi)) By adding this term the NR algorithm didn't converge due to numerical instability so we used the the expectation to get rid of y and ensure convergence
  
  h11 <- -sum(w)
  h12 <- -sum(w * x)
  h22 <- -sum(w * x^2)
  
  matrix(c(h11, h12,
           h12, h22),
         nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)
}
```

```{r}

# Newton–Raphson algorithm for probit link
Newton.Raphson <- function(beta.init, x, y, max.its = 10){
  
  beta <- beta.init
  lld<- c(numeric(max.its), numeric(max.its))
  
  # Norm of the score at initial value
  lld [1] <- c(gradient(beta0, x, y)[1], gradient(beta0, x, y)[2])
  
  for(i in 2:max.its+1){
    
    grad <- gradient(beta, x, y)
    H <- hess(beta, x, y)
    
    beta.new <- as.vector(beta - solve(H) %*% grad)
    
    lld <- c(gradient(beta.new, x, y)[1], gradient(beta.new, x, y)[2])
    
    beta <- beta.new
    
    cat("Iteration", i-1,
    ": betahat.0 =", beta[1],
    "betahat.1 =", beta[2],
    "log-likelihood derivative at beta.0 =", lld[1],
    "at beta.1 =", lld[2],
    "\n \n")
  }
  
  cat("<----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------> \n", "betahat.final = (",beta[1], ",", beta[2], ") Final loglikelihood derivatives value", lld[1], "at beta.0 and at beta.1 ", lld[2], "\n")
  beta
}
```


```{r}
# application
x = shuttle$temp
y = shuttle$damage
beta0 = qnorm(mean(y))
beta.init = c(beta0, 0)
betahat <- Newton.Raphson(beta.init, x, y)
```
# e)
```{r}
# compitation of the asymptotic standard errors of the estimators.
I_obs  <- -hess(betahat, x, y) # fisher information
VarHat <- solve(I_obs) # variance of betahat under normality assumption
SE     <- sqrt(diag(VarHat)) # standard errors computation for beta 0 and beta 1 respectively

SE
```
The error is larger for beta 0 compared to beta 1.
